title: Private Deployments Q2 Capability Matrix & Cross-Team Sequencing
creator: Aisha Kaur
description:
Goal: Produce an actionable quarterly capability matrix and cross-team sequencing plan for Private (VPC/on-prem) feature work that maps to our Q2 OKRs. This ticket coordinates PM + Eng + Design + Security to: (1) surface candidate capabilities for prioritization (RBAC, KMS integrations, upgrade orchestration, telemetry export), (2) validate sequencing constraints (infrastructure dependencies, third-party audits, compliance gating), (3) assign owners and release windows, and (4) produce a single-page plan for exec sign-off and partner/customer communications.

Scope: Focused on enterprise features required for customers targeting SOC2 + regional data residency in EMEA. Excludes routine bug remediation or ongoing Dedicated capacity infra work except where it blocks an MVP capability.

Deliverables:
- A capability matrix (priority, owner, dependencies, risk, customer ask count) for ~8 candidate features.
- A sequenced quarterly plan with milestones and release windows (canary -> GA).
- Risk register with mitigation and rollback playbooks.
- Updated OKR mapping and acceptance criteria for each capability.

Success criteria:
- Exec sign-off on the plan by 2026-04-01.
- Dependencies with engineering owners identified for >95% of features.
- At least two features scheduled for Q2 GA that address top customer asks for private deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Capability matrix populated with priority, owner, estimated effort, and dependencies for all candidate items
Sequencing plan includes milestone dates and canary/GA window for each feature
Security review status and required audit steps documented for each high-risk item
Communication plan draft for early-access customers and CSMs
